appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: an upright shrub of many slender straight grey stems, silvery-woolly ovate leaves in pairs, and woolly clusters of small violet flowers at the branch ends.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for desert lavender from its sources and the photos the traits cite, on the template of snowbrush ceanothus (ceanothus-velutinus); the rest of its growth comes from the library's rules for the form. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 1.8 m tall at 10 years in the open, within its sources' range, as it grows on a Sonoran Desert bajada. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
